Subject: SentiTrust migration validation & proposed cutover tempo

Hi Oliver —

Good to meet yesterday. Per our conversation, I wanted to put a short validation plan on email so we have a shared baseline before we lock the swap window. High level asks:

- Controlled validation traffic (staging mirror) for 72 hours with full KV caching enabled
- Two throughput profiles: steady-state (10k qps daily traffic mix) and burst test (2x peak for 30m)
- Acceptance gates: 95th perc latency < 220ms, token cost delta < 15% vs hosted baseline, zero error-rate regression on canonical prompts
- Cutover tempo proposal: 3-day staged swap (canary → ramp → final) with daily acceptance check-ins at 10:00 PT

Attached is a sizing matrix (sizing-matrix-v2.xlsx) and a draft cutover playbook.

Questions for you: can your infra team provide a mirror endpoint and a contact for network whitelisting? Also flag any blackout dates next two weeks.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

Oliver / Marissa —

Quick technical readout on sizing assumptions after I reviewed the attached matrix:

- Baseline model: 13B encoder-decoder family (quantized fp8 path). For SentiTrust prompt mix we're estimating ~0.9 tokens/sec per GPU at steady-state under our batching profile.
- Suggested staging fleet: 12x A100-equivalent slots for steady-state profile; add 4x slots for burst headroom (total 16) — this keeps the 95th under the 220ms target in our lab sims.
- KV caching: enable prefix caching for repetitive login/case prompts; schedule cache warms 2 hours before canary traffic starts.
- Canary sizing: run canary at 10% traffic for first 6 hours, validate latency and token-accuracy metrics.
- Fallback plan: if token-cost delta > 18% or latency regresses > 25%, auto-failover to hosted variant for the affected route (we'll coordinate the routing policy).

I can push a lightweight validation script to your ops team; see attachment validation-scripts-list.txt.

Ben Carter
Director, Dedicated Operations | Redwood Inference

Thanks — to align on next steps from a schedule perspective, proposed timeline:

- Wed 24 Jun: Staging mirror up (CloudOps + SentiTrust) — whitelist IPs earlier that morning.
- Thu 25 Jun: Controlled steady-state validation run (24h), daily sync 10:00 PT.
- Fri 26 Jun: Burst profile (2x) window + canary day for ramp start.
- Sat 27 Jun: Ramp → final decision by 16:00 PT for go/no-go.

We can compress to a tight 48-hour plan if you must be live before Jul 2, but that requires adding an extra 8 GPUs for parallel canary runs (non-negotiable to keep risk low).

I'll slot engineering on-call for the windows listed. Please confirm whether you want the compressed path.
